items.exampleEn: He spoke briefly about his trip.
items.exampleZh: 他簡短地談了一下他的旅行。

items.exampleEn: The view from the top was incredible.
items.exampleZh: 從山頂看出去的景色美得令人難以置信。

items.exampleEn: There has been rapid growth in the number of online shops.
items.exampleZh: 網路商店的數量快速成長。

items.exampleEn: The new machine has improved our efficiency.
items.exampleZh: 新機器提高了我們的效率。

items.exampleEn: I have absolute trust in my best friend.
items.exampleZh: 我對我最好的朋友絕對信任。

items.exampleEn: My brother is of medium height.

items.exampleZh: 現在的確切時間是幾點？

items.exampleEn: Surprisingly, nobody came to the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 出乎意料地，沒有人來開會。

items.sentenceEn: The rain stopped briefly, then started again.
items.sentenceZh: 雨短暫停了一下，接著又開始下。

items.audioEn: The shirt comes in small, medium, and large, but the medium size is sold out.
items.audioZh: 這件襯衫有小、中、大三種尺寸，但中號已經賣完了。

items.sentenceEn: The town has seen rapid changes in recent years.
items.sentenceZh: 這個小鎮近年來變化很快。

items.sentenceEn: He told us an incredible story about his trip to the jungle.
items.sentenceZh: 他跟我們講了一個他去叢林旅行的驚人故事。

items.stemEn: Please tell me the ____ number of people coming to the party.
items.stemZh: 請告訴我來參加派對的確切人數。

items.stemEn: The exam was ____ easy, so everyone finished early.
items.stemZh: 考試出乎意料地簡單，所以大家都提早寫完。

items.passageEn: Last month, a new cafe opened near my school. Its owner installed a robot that makes drinks with incredible speed. When I ordered a medium tea, the robot made it in less than a minute, and it always uses the exact amount of sugar you ask for. The owner briefly explained how it works. Thanks to the robot's rapid work, the cafe's efficiency is very high: it can serve two hundred drinks an hour. Surprisingly, the drinks taste great, too. Still, I don't think it is an absolute success: I miss chatting with a real person.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我學校附近開了一家新咖啡店。老闆安裝了一台機器人，做飲料的速度快得令人難以置信。我點了一杯中杯茶，機器人不到一分鐘就做好了，而且它總是放你要求的確切糖量。老闆簡短地說明了它的運作方式。多虧機器人工作迅速，這家店的效率非常高：一小時可以供應兩百杯飲料。出乎意料地，飲料也很好喝。不過，我覺得這還不算完全成功：我懷念和真人聊天。

options: 一杯加了很多糖的果汁

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼覺得這還不算完全成功？
options: 覺得飲料的價錢實在太貴了
機器人常常把飲料弄錯

referenceEn: I need the exact address, please.
rubricZh: exact 表示「確切的」，例如 the exact address 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 她只花三個月就學會開車，真是難以置信。
referenceEn: It is incredible that she learned to drive in only three months.
It's incredible that she learned to drive in just three months.
rubricZh: 用 incredible 表示「難以置信的」（例如 It is incredible that…）
